projects.title: Data Hygiene Toolkit
projects.description: A centralized platform for managing data quality workflows at scale — this toolkit enables teams to define, execute, and monitor custom data validation and cleaning rules across datasets. It blends rule-based logic with flexibility for custom SQL checks, while supporting collaboration, user roles, and auditability.
features: Custom Rule Engine where users define their own validation logic
Schema-aware rule builder with a flexible form-based interface
User auth system with roles (admin, analyst, viewer) and secure access control
Integration tests simulating full validation workflows
Fully containerized for local dev & production deploys
projects.technologies: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Next.js, Tailwindcss, Power BI, Python, Docker
projects.fullDescription:
A comprehensive data hygiene solution designed to improve data quality through validation, standardization, and monitoring. The tool provides a modular framework for defining and applying data quality rules across various datasets.

Key Features:
- Modular validation system with 30+ built-in rules for common data quality checks
- Editable grid interface for efficient data review and correction
- Comprehensive Power BI dashboards for monitoring data quality metrics
- Support for multiple export formats (CSV, Excel, JSON)
- User management and permission system for team collaboration

Technical Implementation:
- Backend: FastAPI with PostgreSQL for data storage and processing
- Frontend: Angular with Material Design components
- Analytics: Power BI integration for data visualization
- Deployment: Containerized with Docker for easy deployment

This tool helps organizations maintain high-quality data by providing a centralized platform for data validation, cleaning, and monitoring.

projects.title: InsightBot – AI-Powered University Chatbot
projects.description: A Streamlit-based chatbot that helps international students explore universities by budget, weather, and field, with personalized recommendations using OpenAI API and ChromaDB.
features: Personalized university recommendations based on budget and preferences
Integration with OpenWeather API for climate information
Cost and job data analysis across 25+ US states
Context-aware responses using ChromaDB for knowledge retrieval
User-friendly interface for exploring educational options
projects.technologies: Python, Streamlit, OpenAI API, ChromaDB, OpenWeather API
projects.fullDescription:
InsightBot is an AI-powered chatbot designed to assist international students in making informed decisions about their higher education in the United States. The application provides personalized recommendations based on various factors including academic preferences, budget constraints, and lifestyle considerations.

Key Features:
- Natural language processing for intuitive user interactions
- Context-aware recommendations using OpenAI's language models
- Integration with OpenWeather API for climate information
- Comprehensive database of universities with detailed program information
- Cost of living and job market analysis for different regions

Technical Implementation:
- Frontend: Streamlit for rapid application development
- AI: OpenAI API for natural language understanding and generation
- Database: ChromaDB for efficient vector storage and retrieval
- External APIs: OpenWeather for climate data, various sources for cost and job data

This project demonstrates my ability to build practical AI applications that solve real-world problems by combining multiple technologies and data sources.

projects.title: Influencer Analysis for Business Marketing
projects.description: A comprehensive data analysis project that evaluates influencer marketing effectiveness across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, providing actionable insights for business marketing strategies.
features: Cross-platform analysis of 3,000+ influencers (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube)
Engagement rate analysis and performance metrics comparison
Data visualization of influencer reach and audience demographics
Actionable insights for influencer selection and campaign strategy
projects.technologies: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Jupyter
projects.fullDescription:
This project provides a data-driven approach to influencer marketing by analyzing performance metrics across multiple social media platforms. The analysis helps businesses identify the most effective influencers and optimize their marketing strategies.

Key Insights and Analysis:
- Platform Comparison: Evaluated performance differences between TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube influencers
- Engagement Metrics: Analyzed likes, comments, shares, and views to determine true engagement rates
- Follower Analysis: Studied the relationship between follower count and engagement quality
- Content Performance: Identified which types of content generate the highest engagement
- Demographic Insights: Mapped influencer reach across different regions and audience segments

Technical Implementation:
- Data Collection: Aggregated data from multiple social media platforms
- Data Cleaning: Processed and normalized datasets using Pandas and NumPy
- Statistical Analysis: Performed correlation and regression analysis on engagement metrics
- Visualization: Created interactive visualizations using Matplotlib and Seaborn
- Tools: Jupyter Notebook for reproducible analysis and documentation

Business Impact:
- Helps businesses identify cost-effective influencers with high engagement rates
- Provides data-backed recommendations for influencer selection
- Enables precise targeting of marketing campaigns
- Reduces marketing spend wastage by focusing on high-performing content types

This project showcases my ability to transform raw social media data into actionable business intelligence, demonstrating strong skills in data analysis, visualization, and strategic thinking.
